name: claude-control
description: Manage persistent local Claude sessions from Codex with explicit models and verified results.

interface.shortDescription: Manage local Sonnet and Fable sessions.
interface.longDescription: Manage and monitor local Claude sessions, task revisions, queues, bounded review workflows and explicit plan-edit-review compositions. The read-only TUI shows signed-in Codex, Claude, Gemini and Cursor quota usage without exposing credentials. Workspace policies add controller-mediated edits, isolated named checks and frozen results for Codex approval. Linux and Windows are supported; Windows session control uses a pinned native helper and Windows workspaces use WSL2 with Bubblewrap. Native Claude tools and cross-host dispatch remain disabled.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Claude Control to delegate a local task and verify its result.
